line: The run was clean. The rate was clean too. I'll take the low side, but not the long haul.
The job was clear, the pay was light — I’ll take the light when the path stays clear.
The job closed cleanly. The payout was clean, too. Maybe next time we can aim for something that doesn't leave both of us feeling underdressed.
It ran smooth and paid nothing special. I expect better from the both of us, Shiny.
Low risk, low reward — that’s the deal we made. I don’t mind the risk, but I do mind the reward.
The job was clean, and the pay was clean too — but I prefer my pockets heavier than my conscience.
The job was safe, the pay was thin. I’ve seen safer jobs pay better. Let’s keep looking.
Safe work. Low pay. I’m not upset — I just need better numbers to work with.

No one got hurt, but the take was small. I’ll note that, and think twice before chasing this kind of quiet.

It ran clean and quiet. The money was clean and quiet too. I prefer my work loud, Shiny.

Safe and modest. That’s the kind of job that keeps the books tidy and the risks low — but never the accounts fat.
Shiny. The delivery was clean, the pay was light — but at least no one had to chase it.
This one was quiet, paid in full, and left me with nothing to argue about — which is a first.
The job ran clean. The rate was low. I’ll take the clean, but I’d rather take more.
